transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I'm here because... well, dispatch and compliance have been tracking my route changes. They do it through the computer system, and I hear these little comments on the radio. People try to tell me it’s just normal oversight, but I can tell certain drivers are reporting on me.
When you hear those comments on the radio, do you believe they are actual messages meant specifically for you?

Yes, they definitely are. Like I was just saying, they use the computer system to track my route changes, and then the things they say on the radio... they line up exactly with where I am and what I'm doing. So I know they're directed at me. 

Other people try to brush it off and tell me it's just normal oversight, but it's not. I can just tell that certain drivers are reporting on me to dispatch, and those little comments are their way of letting me know they're watching.
Have you used methamphetamine or any other stimulant recently?
No, I haven't. I don't use methamphetamine or... or any drugs like that. I just go to work and do my job.
Have you had any major medical or neurological problem recently, like a head injury, seizure, or brain illness?
No, I haven't had anything like that. No head injuries or... seizures or anything. I'm physically fine. It's really just the situation at work that's been going on.
Aside from the radio comments, have you been hearing voices when no one is actually speaking?
No, I don't hear voices or anything like that. It's just the stuff coming over the dispatch radio. I don't hear people talking when there's no one there.
Have you felt that your thoughts are being controlled or put into your mind by someone else?
No, definitely not. My thoughts are... they're my own. I haven't felt like anyone is controlling them or putting things in my head.
How long has this been going on?
It's been building up for about eight months now. Um, it started right around the time they put me in the temporary dispatch lead role at work.
Since this started, has your ability to work or manage your day-to-day life gotten worse?

Yeah, it has. At work, I’ve... well, I've fallen behind on my route reports. And I guess my instructions over the radio have gotten confusing enough that some of the drivers are actually complaining about it. And at home, I'm just not keeping up. My husband has had to take over making the meals, handling phone calls, and just doing the basic planning for us because I can't seem to manage it right now.
Since this started, have you found yourself talking much less than usual?
No, I don't think so. I mean, I still talk to my husband and the drivers at work. I haven't really noticed that I'm talking any less than I usually do.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient has a persistent persecutory/referential delusional belief lasting about 8 months, with significant decline in occupational and home functioning. Substance-induced and medical causes were specifically denied, and there is no evidence that the symptoms are better explained by mood episodes. Although hallucinations and thought insertion are denied, schizophrenia ICD-10 F20.0 can be diagnosed when prominent delusions persist with functional deterioration and no organic/substance cause is evident.
